description: This file defines a PHP class 'DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams' which extends 'FilterParams'. It encapsulates search filter parameters such as fromDate, toDate, and empNumber, used for filtering timesheets in the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) to encapsulate filter parameters for searching timesheets, including date range and employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter parameter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter parameter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter parameter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
